note: ADR-0500 withdrew the URL-in-`--database` spelling, so a URL there must stay a usage error naming `--load <url>`; the remote bundle goes through `--load`, reusing ADR-0496's GitHub rewrite, https-only policy, `.cl` requirement and capped streaming staged fetch, and the downloaded scratch copy is released like a local source.

The `query` command already has a decided grammar: a first-positional statement-session verb taking `[STATEMENT] [--database PATH]` plus session flags, `-c` exclusive with the positional, and a shared help block, with did-you-mean applying on its usage-error exits.

Add the new procedure with no database argument (ADR-0227 signatures), put it in the always-built cypherlite-ontology crate, include it in the `CYPHERLITE_PREVIEW=ontology` gate, add it to SHOW PROCEDURES, follow the transaction and no-privilege rules, and keep it in the catalogue.

Extend the re-arrival trail-existence rule (ADR-0478 §3) in the frontier kernel, keeping accept-on-arrival before dedup, the answer-shape gate, and the work budget with its run-time fall-through to the DFS, and keeping the single range-quantified region compile rule.

ADR-0306 already decides post-verb `--read-only`/`--follow` on `serve` and the Docker entrypoint's valueless-flag passthrough, but the standalone `cypherlite-mcp` bin was retired by ADR-0368, so MCP read-only/follow must go through `serve --mcp` (stdio or port).

The `snapshot` verb already has a decided design (ADR-0159): an exit-after positional with `--to`/`--from`, a read-only source open, a destination that must not exist, the source codec kept, `snapshot_to_bundle`/`restore_from_bundle` engine methods, and no new Cargo feature.
